insights.one_liner: GXO is a US-owned contract-logistics company running warehouses for other brands, with Dutch entities that are IND-recognised visa sponsors.

culture.text: GXO runs warehouses and distribution centres on behalf of other companies.
Its 2 open jobs here are both in finance, in Oude Meer (near Schiphol) and Lelystad.
It is investing in robotics and automation in its warehouses.

open.text: Three Dutch GXO entities, including GXO Logistics Netherlands B.V., are IND recognised sponsors.
Both current postings are open to non-Dutch speakers; they average 73 LinkedIn applicants each.
The Dutch companies are ultimately owned by GXO Logistics, Inc. in the US.

growth.text: GXO signed a 10-year logistics deal with Columbia Sportswear for Europe.
GXO and Exotec are partnering on fashion fulfilment for Guess in the Netherlands.
GXO said it is expanding its technology organisation and is piloting a global labour management system ahead of a 2027 rollout.

worth_knowing.text: The UK competition watchdog has concluded its probe into GXO's takeover of Wincanton.
Analysts note GXO is winning business at lower margins.
